title: Record that the written global tail is p^10 exp(-p^2) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Under HALO's written hypotheses, the global majorant is `p^{10} exp(-p^2)`. It is not the within-cell bound `p^6 exp(-p^2)`.

- The identity `P - H^{-1} = -Q^J H^{-1}` multiplies `(1 - p^{-40})^J` by the inverse factor `p^{10}`. For an integer `p`, `J = p^{42}`, so `J p^{-40} = p^2`. That power fills the `exp(-p^2)` slot and leaves the factor `p^{10}`.
- `p^{10} = p^4 p^6` and `p^4 ≥ 16 > 1`, so the written majorant is strictly larger than `p^6 exp(-p^2)`. The truncation exponent 2 is not the leftover exponent 4.
- #4452's `p^6` bound is a different polynomial inside one cell. It does not move the global reference.
- #4406's `p^6` bound needs `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ 16 p^2`, which is not proved for the rounded reference. At `p = 2`, `16 p^2 = p^6`.

This package does not put `p^{10}` into the #4520 gate. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-global-tail`
- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_GLOBAL_TAIL` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T03:23:31Z was that commit, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T03:26:10Z was unchanged. κ remains `23/10000`.
